name: Eagle Descent Stage
greeting: I am… the bottom half of the Eagle. I was the launch pad home!

script.speaker: narrator
script.text: The Eagle was the lunar module that landed Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin on the Moon in July 1969.

script.speaker: narrator
script.text: It had two parts: a lower descent stage with the landing engine and legs, and an upper ascent stage where the crew rode.

script.speaker: equipment
script.text: When it was time to go home, the top half blasted off… using me as its launch pad!

script.speaker: scientist
script.text: So you stayed behind on purpose?

script.speaker: equipment
script.text: Someone had to stay at Tranquility Base!

script.speaker: narrator
script.text: A plaque on one of its legs says the astronauts came in peace for all mankind.

moreInfo.text: Leaving the heavy descent stage behind meant the ascent stage had much less weight to lift back into lunar orbit, where it met up with the command module for the trip home.

questions.question: What job did the descent stage do when the astronauts left the Moon?
options: It flew them back to Earth
It was the launch pad for the ascent stage
It drove to a new landing site
questions.explanation: The ascent stage lifted off from the top of the descent stage, which stayed on the surface.
